panels.title: Unlocked channels
panels.description: Downstream and upstream channels reporting unlocked. Should be zero.

panels.title: Lowest RxMER
panels.description: Worst channel right now. Ziggo rates above 33 dB as good, so this going red means at least one channel is struggling.

panels.title: Ranging timeouts, 1h
panels.description: New T1 to T4 timeouts across all upstream channels in the last hour. Anything above zero means the upstream had trouble.

panels.title: Provisioned down
panels.description: Maximum rate the CMTS has provisioned.

panels.title: Device
panels.description: Firmware appears once modem.py has run with MODEM_PASSWORD set, which is what fills firmware.log.

panels.title: Downstream power, across all channels
panels.description: Ziggo rates -7 to +7 dBmV as good, out to +/-11 tolerated. The dashed lines mark those bands. Per-channel values are in the table below.

panels.title: Downstream RxMER, across all channels
panels.description: Ziggo rates above 33 dB as good. SNR tracks RxMER closely on this modem and is in the table below.

panels.title: FEC corrected
panels.description: Codewords FEC repaired. Normal, and much higher on OFDM because it carries far more codewords.

panels.title: FEC uncorrected
panels.description: Codewords FEC could not repair, which is real packet loss. On its own scale because corrected dwarfs it.

panels.title: Downstream channels
panels.description: Every downstream channel with its current values, coloured against Ziggo's ranges. This is where you find which channel the summary charts are complaining about.

panels.title: Upstream power, ATDMA
panels.description: Ziggo rates 35 to 49 dBmV as good, up to 51 tolerated.

panels.title: Upstream power, OFDMA
panels.description: Ziggo rates 30 to 45 dBmV as good. OFDMA sits lower than ATDMA on purpose, because it is measured across a wider block of spectrum. That is normal and not a fault.

panels.title: Ranging timeouts
panels.description: New DOCSIS ranging timeouts per interval. T3 bursts mean the upstream is struggling, T4 is worse.

panels.title: Upstream channels
panels.description: Every upstream channel. ATDMA reports a centre frequency and OFDMA a channel width, so each type fills one of those two columns. T3 and T4 are totals since the modem last booted, not a rate. Power is not coloured here because the good range differs by channel type, which the two charts above handle.

panels.title: Event log entries by priority
panels.description: Entries currently in the modem's rolling log window. These are gauges, not counters, so no rate() on them.

panels.title: CM-STATUS events in window
panels.description: 4 MDD recovery, 20 NCP profile failure, 21 PLC failure, 22 NCP profile recovery.

panels.title: Current channel profiles
panels.description: Most recent profile the CMTS assigned per channel, read from the event log.

panels.title: Modem poll duration
panels.description: How long the exporter needs to read every endpoint. This happens on a background thread, so Prometheus scrapes stay instant regardless.

panels.title: Last poll age
panels.description: Time since the last poll attempt, updates even if the modem was unreachable. Alert on this going stale, see alerts.yml.
